sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production transparent RGBA sprite atlas for the unique scene "A neighborhood flower stall overflowing with wrapped bouquets". Match a premium cozy storybook painted mobile puzzle: rich dimensional gouache-like digital painting, delicate brushed pigment, believable natural details, softly warm upper-left sunlight, tactile materials and clean silhouettes. No vector simplification, no photographic collage, no geometric filler. The finished background is a gently elevated three-quarter view painted composition. All objects share that light and perspective. This is an asset sheet, not a scene: true transparent alpha, no RGB colored matte, NO frame or grid lines, NO cell border or rectangular shadow. Strict 3 columns by 2 rows, 3:2 landscape image. Each of the five objects must be isolated INSIDE the central 60% of its own cell, leaving at least 20% empty transparent gutter on ALL FOUR SIDES. Nothing may touch or cross any cell boundary; steam and fine strands must also stay inside those gutters. Bottom-right sixth cell must be perfectly empty transparent, including no faint artifacts. Five cells read left to right: top-left a short ivory-and-lavender tasseled cord hanging vertically, top attachment narrow, bottom soft fan; top-middle one pink sweet-pea flower sprig with green leaves and a long tapered bottom stem, seen upright; top-right a curving ivy branch with small warm sunlit leaves and a narrow bottom stem; bottom-left one small loosely tied deep violet silk bow with two soft dangling tails; bottom-middle a tiny pale yellow cabbage butterfly in three-quarter view. Paint exactly these five separate details; no labels, typography, scenery, containers, confetti, or extra objects. Preserve detailed natural alpha edges and translucent painted material where specified.
